query: Which maternal mediators (time-use, caregiving, home-learning, schooling expenditures, maternal labor supply) exist per dataset and which causal mediation or SEM approaches and assumptions will we pre-specify?

response.query: Which maternal mediators (time-use, caregiving, home-learning, schooling expenditures, maternal labor supply) exist per dataset and which causal mediation or SEM approaches and assumptions will we pre-specify?
response.answer: Maternal mediators include time-use, caregiving, home-learning, schooling expenditures, and maternal labor supply. We will pre-specify causal mediation analysis and structural equation modeling approaches, assuming no unmeasured confounders.
